notes: VD04 uses Tongsheng 0x59 UART. ParseDisplayUartFrame writes PAS 0–6 to 0x20002706 and max speed to 0x20002705 when the speed byte is greater than 10 or the wheel code also changes past 5. Handlebar on-road/off-road hold-toggle stays on the display; the motor has one ceiling and applies whichever km/h the display sends.

UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit (0x10008810) compares the P0.4 wheel-pulse period at 0x20002590 to kmh<<5 (stock 25 → 800) and writes display TX bit 0x40000. That cell is a period (stopped 4100), not km/h. Live motor taper is ApplyWheelSpeedFade. Unplugging the sensor leaves the period high (stopped), not low. Other movs #0x19 sites are an 800-tick timeout, a current-staging +800, fade-hi*25/22, and a torque-path 25<<5 at 0x1000834A.

ApplyAssistLevelTargets maps PAS 1–5 to percent immediates (30/50/70/85/100) at g_bAssistPercent (0x200026F9). CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent multiplies filtered torque demand by that byte. A separate FOC cap at g_wScaledAssist uses soft-float 0.4/0.5/0.8/0.9/1.0. PAS1/PAS3 share mantissa low-word 0x9999999A (locked); the high words are pas1_foc_scale / pas3_foc_scale. PAS4 0.9 at 0x10002FDC is independently patchable. PAS2 FOC is ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo(-n) via pas2_foc_scale (stock n=1 → 0.5).

PAS 0 is zero. PAS 6 is walk: RunRideControlLoop stores 450 into wCurrentTarget (ride-state+0x12). ApplyAssistLevelTargets then zeros the percent cell, writes walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths of full current (stock 3/16) into g_wAssistCurrentTarget, and writes walk_foc_scale_sixteenths of max current (stock 1/16) into g_wScaledAssist.

Startup 1000 / 728 / 641 in InitializeRideDefaults seed fade RAM (0x200025AC / 0x2000258A / 0x20002588). RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds rebuilds them from wheel×speed, so the flash immediates do not stick. They are not in this map.

Rider settings change everyday speed/PAS/walk behavior. Advanced tunables are FOC, stall, hall, wheel-pulse timing, PAS asymmetry, torque confirm, and protection constants — wrong values can stall, cut assist, or rotate commutation.

The VD04 max speed byte is 60. Raising the Speed ceiling slider only changes the display-status period compare. Live assist taper follows the fade table from wheel×display speed. Unlimit-when-display-60 remaps a stored 60 to 99 for fade math and forces display TX bit 0x40000 always on (bcc→b at 0x10008824) so the VD04 handshake is not stuck in legal 25/PAS 1. Disable-fade rewrites two short bcs in ApplyWheelSpeedFade to b (0x100088F6 and 0x10008922, same sites as donor patched HEX) so taper is skipped on both display 25 and 60. Analog throttle overlay is separate: RunRideControlLoop stages (ADC−600)×2+800 when PAS≠0 and ADC is in window, then ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS-full bumps FOC to PAS 5. Skip-throttle-lockout nops the bmi that skips that map when dwAssistBits 0x40000 is set (assist word 0x20002690, not the display TX 0x40000). Off-road unlimit also drops the analog window start to 840 (lockout release). Unlimit-power skips the battery over/under-voltage flags and low-voltage foldback; its raise-slew site can still wind the limit down when avg < UV. Ride current clamp 0 keeps the derived g_wFullCurrentLimit; 450–32767 replaces ConvertFloatToSignedInt with a Thumb uint16. Display max-speed is accepted only when the UART byte is greater than 10.

parameters.label: Speed ceiling
parameters.summary: Display-status period threshold encoded as km/h then <<5 (stock 25 → 800 ticks). Sets TX bit 0x40000 when wheel period is below that. Because period shrinks as speed rises, a higher slider value asserts the bit at lower wheel speeds. Live motor taper is Speed fade / Unlimit-when-display-60, not this compare.
parameters.notes: UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit: movs r3,#imm; lsls #5; blo sets display TX 0x40000 when P0.4 period at 0x20002590 is below the threshold. Period is written by UpdateWheelPulsePeriod (stopped 4100, boot seed 4500), not a km/h<<5 speed. Raising the immediate raises the period ceiling, so the bit turns on sooner (slower). Rebuild fade periods use ~573*wheel/speed, so stock 800 ticks is nearer ~20 km/h on wheel code 28 than a hard 25 km/h wall. Assist taper is ApplyWheelSpeedFade. Unlimit-when-display-60 forces the period compare blo to always take the SET path (bcc→b at 0x10008824); it does not change this km/h immediate.

parameters.label: Ride current clamp
parameters.summary: Upper clamp on ride-loop current (throttle and PAS). 0 keeps the stock 6200 firmware-unit convert. 32767 is signed-16 max so the analog throttle map is not cut while the ble still bounds demand.
parameters.notes: ComputeMotorScaleTables: stock converts the fixed float 6200.0 at 0x10003A44 (scale base+0x98) via ConvertFloatToSignedInt into g_wFullCurrentLimit (0x200025E2). That is a constant, not a pack-current-derived value. PAS 1–5 copies that word into g_wAssistCurrentTarget, then RunRideControlLoop ble-clamps wCurrentTarget to both. 0 leaves the convert. 450–32767 replaces the six bytes with movs r0,#hi; lsls #8; adds #lo so the ble still runs. Skipping those ble instructions lets throttle stage (ADC-600)*2+800 unbounded and the motor twitches. Walk’s +0x12 450 immediate is separate. Can overheat the controller.

parameters.label: Throttle ADC low edge
parameters.summary: Low edge of the analog throttle window as a signed offset (stock −1241). The live window is abs(this) through abs(this)+span. Shared with the PAS-full override path.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: adc + this literal is compared to throttle_adc_span (stock 2359) so 1241 ≤ ADC < 3600. The same −1241 word is also loaded by ApplyAssistLevelTargets for the PAS-full override (span throttle_pas_full_span 2679 → ADC < 3920). A second −1241 at 0x100089B8 is fade_throttle_adc_low (ApplyWheelSpeedFade) and is not this slider.

parameters.label: Throttle ADC span
parameters.summary: Width of the analog throttle window (stock 2359). High ADC = abs(low edge) + span, so stock is 1241+2359 = 3600. Unique literal; 3600 is not stored.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop unsigned compare after adding throttle_adc_low. One xref. The PAS-full override uses throttle_pas_full_span 2679 at 0x100033E8, not this word.

parameters.label: PAS-full throttle span
parameters.summary: Width of the throttle window that forces PAS 1–5 to full current (stock 2679). High ADC = abs(low edge) + this span, so stock is 1241+2679 = 3920.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets: adc + throttle_adc_low compared to this unique literal. One xref. Walk and PAS 0 skip the override. Separate from the analog throttle map span 2359.

parameters.label: Throttle lockout release
parameters.summary: Clears the throttle lockout when throttle ADC is below this (stock 840). Raise if a resting aftermarket throttle sits above 840 and never unlocks.
parameters.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog: movs r3,#imm; lsls #3 then cmp the throttle ADC at 0x20002528. Stock 0x69<<3 = 840. Else-if ADC < 840 clears assist bit 0x40000. Unique movs. The lsls #3 is fingerprint-locked.

parameters.label: Throttle ADC offset
parameters.summary: Subtracted from averaged throttle ADC before the ×2 gain (stock 600). Formula is (ADC − offset)×2 + bias.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: unique movs r0,#imm; lsls #3 at 0x10003312. Formula (ADC-offset)×2+bias, then uxth. Max 1240 stays at or below the stock throttle-window low edge so a closed throttle cannot wrap to a huge current. Fade floor and LoadMotorScaleDefaults also use 75<<3 = 600 with different registers; those sites stay put.

parameters.label: Throttle ADC bias
parameters.summary: Added after the throttle ×2 gain (stock 800). Same 25<<5 encoding as the speed wall, but this movs is r0 not r3.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop unique 19 20 40 01. The 800-tick timeout and torque-path 25<<5 use 19 21 49 01 and are fingerprint-locked.

parameters.label: Throttle ramp-down bulk threshold
parameters.summary: Downward throttle-target errors larger than this use the bulk asrs path instead of −1 per tick (stock 15).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle slew: cmp r2,#imm before asrs. Pair with throttle_ramp_down_shift so the threshold stays near 2^N−1 for a smooth hand-off.

parameters.label: Throttle ramp-down shift
parameters.summary: Bulk throttle ramp-down step is delta>>N when above the bulk threshold (stock N=4 → /16).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle path: asrs r2,#N after cmp vs throttle_ramp_down_bulk_threshold. Larger N = slower release. Keep the bulk threshold near 2^N−1.

parameters.label: Throttle ramp-up bulk threshold
parameters.summary: Upward throttle-target errors larger than this use the bulk asrs path instead of +1 per tick (stock 31).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle slew: cmp r2,#imm before asrs. Pair with throttle_ramp_up_shift so the threshold stays near 2^N−1 for a smooth hand-off.

parameters.label: Throttle ramp-up shift
parameters.summary: Bulk throttle ramp-up step is delta>>N when above the bulk threshold (stock N=5 → /32).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop throttle path: asrs r2,#N after cmp vs throttle_ramp_up_bulk_threshold. Smaller N = snappier throttle. Keep the bulk threshold near 2^N−1.

parameters.label: Current headroom deadband
parameters.summary: Current limit must exceed measured current by this before headroom steps are generated (stock 70).
parameters.notes: UpdateCurrentHeadroomSlew: adds #imm and matching subs #imm sites (0x10002A38 / 0x10002A42). Headroom steps = (limit-measured-imm)>>5 when limit > measured+imm.

parameters.label: Current headroom slew cap
parameters.summary: Caps the byte-sized current-headroom/slew level (stock 12).
parameters.notes: UpdateCurrentHeadroomSlew: cmp #imm and movs #imm clamp sites (0x10002A7A / 0x10002A7E). Patched together so the compare and the saturating store stay equal.

parameters.label: PWM idle shutdown
parameters.summary: How long ride-loop current can stay at zero before PWM is shut down (stock 200 ticks). Lower drops the motor sooner at a stop.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: sxth then cmp r0,#imm; blt keep running. At the trip: RAM thunk, CCU OR 0xC00, clear protect/assist bits. A second cmp #0xC8 at 0x10007E96 is Ride protect timeout; a third at 0x100087AC is the throttle-ADC watchdog age saturate. Those are separate sliders.

parameters.label: Brake debounce depth
parameters.summary: How many matching samples DebounceBrakeInput needs before the lever is taken as pressed (stock 3, so 4 stable reads).
parameters.notes: DebounceBrakeInput: cmp r1,#imm; if count > imm return the latched level. Unique cmp #3. Lower trips faster; higher ignores short glitches. Active-low PORT0.10.

parameters.label: Hall fault debounce
parameters.summary: Invalid hall codes 0/7 may accumulate above this before fault code 10 latches (stock 3). Counter resets only on the PWM-idle path.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: byte at 0x200025BF; cmp #imm then set flags+4 bit23. Raising hides hall wiring faults; not a consecutive-only debounce.

parameters.label: Fault-code report debounce
parameters.summary: Display fault codes stay suppressed for this many consecutive UpdateMotorFaultCode polls (stock 30). Direct protect-bit motor cuts are unaffected.
parameters.notes: UpdateMotorFaultCode: while code!=0 and counter 0x200025CA < this, force the reported code to 0 and increment. RunRideControlLoop / EnableMotorPwmWhenReady gate on the reported byte at 0x20002B05. 0 reports every fault instantly; large values delay display-error motor cuts.

parameters.label: Default max speed
parameters.summary: Boot-up max speed only. The display overwrites it as soon as it sends a speed greater than 10. Leave this unless the display is unplugged or not talking.
parameters.notes: InitializeRideDefaults writes this byte to both 0x20002705 (live display speed) and 0x20002703 (last-cache). RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds rebuilds the fade table only when those two differ, then copies live→cache. A live 0x59 frame overwrites 0x20002705 when speed > uart_min_display_speed_kmh (or wheel code also changes). Patching this without a display-speed change can leave cache matching live, so the fade table is not rebuilt until the display sends a different byte.

parameters.label: Display speed accept floor
parameters.summary: Display max-speed byte is stored when it is greater than this (stock 10), or when the wheel-size code also changes past uart_min_wheel_code. Silent displays keep the init defaults.
parameters.notes: ParseDisplayUartFrame: speed is written to 0x20002705 when speed > this OR when the wheel code changed and is above uart_min_wheel_code. Not a hard reject of every frame with speed ≤10.

parameters.label: Display wheel-code accept floor
parameters.summary: Changed wheel-size codes are accepted only when greater than this (stock 5). Pair with the display speed accept floor.
parameters.notes: ParseDisplayUartFrame: cmp wheel_code,#imm before storing live wheel/speed. A changed valid wheel code also opens the speed-store path even when speed ≤ uart_min_display_speed_kmh.

parameters.label: Default wheel-size code
parameters.summary: Boot-up wheel-size code (Tongsheng 6–34, stock 28). Not millimeters. The display usually overwrites this; it only matters if the display never sends a wheel byte.
parameters.notes: InitializeRideDefaults stores 0x1C (28) to both 0x20002704 (live wheel code) and 0x20002702 (last-cache). RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds rebuilds fade only when live ≠ last, using the live wheel byte (valid 6–34). Patching this without a display wheel-byte change can skip that rebuild. Silent-display default, not circumference in mm.

parameters.label: Default PAS level
parameters.summary: PAS level used from power-on until the display sends the first valid frame. After that the handlebar buttons own it.
parameters.notes: InitializeRideDefaults writes 5 to 0x20002706 before the first 0x59 frame. ParseDisplayUartFrame then overwrites it from assist-flag bits. Capped at 5 so a silent display cannot boot into walk (PAS 6).

parameters.label: PAS 1 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 1 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 30%). Raise for more help on level 1. This is not the FOC current cap.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets writes 30 to g_bAssistPercent. CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent multiplies filtered torque demand by this byte. The FOC current cap for PAS 1 is a separate soft-float 0.4 and is not this immediate.

parameters.label: PAS 2 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 2 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 50%). Raise for more help on level 2.
parameters.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 50%. FOC cap for PAS 2 is ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo(-n) via pas2_foc_scale (stock n=1 → half of max current), not this byte.

parameters.label: PAS 3 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 3 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 70%). Raise for more help on level 3.
parameters.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 70%. FOC cap is soft-float 0.8; the high word at 0x10002FD8 is PAS 3 FOC scale. PAS 1/3 still share mantissa 0x9999999A.

parameters.label: PAS 4 assist
parameters.summary: How hard PAS 4 pulls from the torque sensor (stock 85%). Raise for more help on level 4.
parameters.notes: Torque-demand multiply is 85%. FOC cap is a separate soft-float 0.9 at 0x10002FDC (PAS 4 FOC scale).

parameters.label: PAS 4 FOC scale
parameters.summary: FOC current cap for PAS 4 as a percent of max current (stock 90%). Independent IEEE double. PAS 1/3 high words are separate sliders; they share mantissa low-word 0x9999999A. PAS 2 FOC scale is the separate halvings slider.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==4 multiplies max current by this little-endian double (stock 0.9). At stock 22 A the 6200 ride-current clamp already sits below 0.9× the derived ceiling, so this slider is inert until Ride current clamp is raised. Do not confuse with PAS 4 assist percent 85.

parameters.label: PAS 1 FOC scale
parameters.summary: FOC current cap for PAS 1 as a percent of max current (stock 40%). High word only; shared mantissa 0x9999999A is locked. Valid percents are 10/20/40/80/160.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==1 multiplies max current by the double (mantissa at 0x10002FD0, this high word). Not the PAS 1 assist percent 30. Encoding rejects values whose IEEE low word would differ from the shared mantissa. At stock 22 A / 6200 clamp this 40% cap is the live PAS 1 FOC ceiling; PAS 3/4 stay clamp-limited.

parameters.label: PAS 3 FOC scale
parameters.summary: FOC current cap for PAS 3 as a percent of max current (stock 80%). High word only; shared mantissa 0x9999999A is locked. Valid percents are 10/20/40/80/160.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==3 uses (DAT_10002fd0, this word). Independent of pas1_foc_scale aside from the locked mantissa. At stock 22 A the 6200 ride-current clamp already sits below 0.8× the derived ceiling, so raising this is inert until Ride current clamp is raised.

parameters.label: PAS 2 FOC scale
parameters.summary: PAS 2 FOC current cap as max_current / 2^n (stock 1 → 50%). Uses ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo, not a soft-float data word.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==2: movs r2,#(n-1); mvns r2,r2 → ScaleDoubleByPowerTwo(..., -n). Stock movs #0; mvns → -1 → half of max current. Valid n 1–4 (50%/25%/12.5%/6.25%). The mvns halfword is fingerprint-locked. At stock 22 A / 6200 clamp this 50% cap is often the live PAS 2 FOC ceiling.

parameters.label: PAS 5 assist
parameters.summary: Strongest pedal-assist level, not walk. Stock is already 100% of the torque-sensor demand.
parameters.notes: Strongest pedal-assist percent (not walk). Torque-demand multiply is 100%. FOC cap copies the max-current setpoint unscaled.

parameters.label: Walk-assist target
parameters.summary: How hard walk-assist pushes (stock 450 firmware units). Does not change how you enter walk on the display, only the current while walk is on.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop when PAS==6: movs r0,#255; adds r0,#imm; strh to ride-state+0x12. Stock 0xC3 gives 450. Then the shared ble clamps cap it against g_wAssistCurrentTarget, which ApplyAssistLevelTargets set to walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths of g_wFullCurrentLimit (stock 3/16). If that fraction of the ride current clamp is below this target, walk cannot reach it.

parameters.label: Walk current fraction
parameters.summary: Walk assist current as this many sixteenths of full current (stock 3 = 3/16). Caps walk when below the 450 walk-assist target.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==6: asrs #3 + asrs #4 of g_wFullCurrentLimit into g_wAssistCurrentTarget. Stock 3/16. Inert at stock because 3/16 of 6200 is above the 450 walk target; it only clamps if Ride current clamp is below about 2400. Must be a sum of two powers of two. Separate walk FOC cap walk_foc_scale_sixteenths (stock 1/16 of max current) is independent.

parameters.label: Walk FOC scale
parameters.summary: Walk FOC current cap as a power-of-two fraction of max current in sixteenths (stock 1 = 1/16). Independent of the walk ride-current fraction.
parameters.notes: ApplyAssistLevelTargets PAS==6: lsls r0,#imm; lsrs r0,#16 of g_wMaxCurrentSetpoint into g_wScaledAssist. Stock lsl #12 → >>4 = 1/16. Valid values 1/2/4/8 (lsl 12/13/14/15). Does not change walk_assist_fraction_sixteenths or the 450 walk target.

parameters.label: Torque engage deadband
parameters.summary: PAS starts only when live torque ADC is above the learned offset plus this (stock 163). Too low twitches at rest; too high feels late.
parameters.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: adds r7,#imm then cmp live ADC. A flag / +0x50>30 path can still engage inside the deadband. Unique adds r7,#0xA3.

parameters.label: Torque sensor gain
parameters.summary: Scales every PAS torque demand as (delta>>a)+(delta>>b) eighths (stock 3 = 3/8). Must be a sum of two powers of two.
parameters.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: asrs #2 + asrs #3 then adds, stored to the torque-delta cell. Stock 3/8 of (ADC-offset). Encoder writes two Thumb asrs imm5 that sum to this many eighths. Values like 7 (three bits) are rejected.

parameters.label: Torque assist rise shift
parameters.summary: Per-tick rise toward torque-assist target uses delta>>N when delta > 2^N−1 (stock N=3). Larger N = slower build-up.
parameters.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: cmp #2^N−1 then lsrs #N into the rise step (else +1). Patches both the compare and the lsrs imm5.

parameters.label: Torque assist fall shift
parameters.summary: Decay step toward the torque-assist target uses delta>>N when delta > 2^N−1 (stock N=2). Larger N = longer assist tail.
parameters.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent fall path: cmp #2^N−1 then lsrs #N. Independent of the rise shift.

parameters.label: Torque ADC slew shift
parameters.summary: How aggressively the ride loop slews the 4-sample torque ADC average into 0x20002710 (stock N=5 → step delta>>5 when |delta|>31).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: two mirror arms each cmp #2^N−1 then asrs #N. All four sites stay in sync. Smaller N tracks pedal torque faster (more noise).

parameters.label: Assist ramp-up shift
parameters.summary: How fast wCurrentTarget rises toward the full-current assist limit when cadence/torque flags are set (stock N=4 → step delta>>4 when delta>15).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop assist branch (cadence bit11 + torque flag bit3): cmp #2^N−1 then asrs #N into wCurrentTarget, then min with g_wAssistCurrentTarget. Runs every 4th ride pass. Larger N = softer onset.

parameters.label: Assist ramp-down shift
parameters.summary: How fast wCurrentTarget falls when the alt full-current limit drops below the live target (stock N=4). Pedal release uses a separate halve-per-pass path.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop assist branch down arm: cmp #2^N−1 then asrs #N. Rarely taken because alt is normally the constant full-current limit; visible mainly when thermal/ride clamps lower that limit.

parameters.label: Torque-slope engage delta
parameters.summary: Minimum torque-ADC rise in one sample window that can wake assist below the static deadband (stock 30).
parameters.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: assist engages when adc > offset+deadband OR (cadence bit11 and (torque flag already set OR 0x200025A8 > this)). 0x200025A8 is written by DecodePasCadencePulseEdges once per torque_adc_rise_window. Lower values engage on smaller pedal pushes (more twitch).

parameters.label: PAS demand floor
parameters.summary: Minimum torque-assist demand after the PAS percent multiply (stock 300). Separate from the FOC slew floor of 300.
parameters.notes: CalculateTorqueAssistCurrent: movs r2,#255; adds r2,#imm; if g_bAssistPercent * filtered_demand < that, store 300 to 0x20002718. The mapped torque slew floor at 0x10008F9C uses the same 255+0x2D encoding in ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit.

parameters.label: Torque hold engage ticks
parameters.summary: Minimum torque-hold counter before the torque-assist confirm path can run (stock 400).
parameters.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: movs #255; adds #imm; cmp hold-count. Stock 0x91 → 400. Paired with Torque engage current floor (900) and the locked torque-path 25<<5 speed compare.

parameters.label: Torque engage current floor
parameters.summary: Published current target must exceed this before torque-assist confirm advances (stock 900).
parameters.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: movs r2,#imm; lsls #2 vs wPublishedCurrentTarget. Stock 0xE1<<2 = 900. Unique movs #0xE1 in this function.

parameters.label: Torque release FOC product
parameters.summary: Clears torque-assist bit 0x10 when the FOC Q15 torque product at 0x20002AC0 falls below this (stock 600).
parameters.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: movs #0x4B; lsls #3; ldrsh from ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr's Q15 product (torque×scale>>15 at 0x20002AC0). Not a wheel-pulse period. Same 75<<3 encoding as the fade floor but a different site. Id kept for compatibility.

parameters.label: Torque confirm count
parameters.summary: How many consecutive in-window torque confirms are required before assist bit 0x10 latches (stock 2 → third confirm).
parameters.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: after the event-count gate, increments wTorqueConfirmCount and cmp #imm; when count > imm, clears counters and ors dwAssistBits 0x10. Unique cmp #2 in this function.

parameters.label: Torque event count cap
parameters.summary: Saturating cap on the torque-event counter that must fill before confirm samples run (stock 10).
parameters.notes: UpdateFocHandoverState: cmp #imm and matching movs #imm store (0x1000835C / 0x10008360). Patched together so the compare and the saturating store stay equal. Below the cap the confirm path does not run.

parameters.label: PAS pulse asymmetry gate
parameters.summary: Minimum published high+low pedal period before the asymmetry glitch check can clear cadence (stock 5).
parameters.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: if (prev_period*2 < high+low) AND (published_period > imm) AND prev_period != 0, clear assist bit 0x800 and timing words. Unique cmp #5 in this function. Lower rejects glitchy PAS edges sooner; higher tolerates uneven magnet spacing.

parameters.label: PAS inactivity timeout
parameters.summary: Clears cadence timing and the PAS-active assist bit after this many unchanged pedal-sensor samples (stock 1000).
parameters.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: movs r7,#imm; lsls #3; while channel A is unchanged the counter rises to this, then clears timing state and assist bit 0x800. Left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

parameters.label: PAS pulse timeout
parameters.summary: Maximum high or low pedal-pulse duration before cadence is invalidated (stock 1500). Trips when the count exceeds this.
parameters.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: unique literal compared against both high-time and low-time pulse counters. On trip clears assist bit 0x800 and resets timing words.

parameters.label: PAS engage pulse count
parameters.summary: Consistent pedal edges required before cadence is accepted (stock 2 → third qualifying edge publishes timing).
parameters.notes: DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: cmp r6,#imm on the rising-edge qualifier counter. Below the threshold the counter increments; at/above it publishes pulse timing and sets assist bit 0x800.

parameters.label: Torque ADC rise window
parameters.summary: How often DecodePasCadencePulseEdges samples torque-ADC rise into 0x200025A8 (stock 50 ticks).
parameters.notes: Tail of DecodePasCadencePulseEdges: while the counter != this, increment and return; on equality store max(0, torqueADC−previous) to 0x200025A8 and reset. Feeds torque_slope_engage_delta — not a PAS cadence-edge timer.

parameters.label: Torque offset drop threshold
parameters.summary: If live torque ADC falls more than this below the learned zero, automatic offset relearning starts (stock 80).
parameters.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: if adc < learned && (learned-adc) > imm, the relearn counter advances. Pair with torque_offset_relearn_count.

parameters.label: Torque offset relearn count
parameters.summary: Consecutive below-offset samples required before the learned torque zero is replaced (stock 100).
parameters.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: both cmp #imm sites (0x10007F90 cap, 0x10007F9A apply). Counter must reach this before *learnedOffset = adcSample.

parameters.label: Torque sensor fault ADC low
parameters.summary: Torque ADC below this after the learn delay sets sensor-fault bit 2 / error 6 and cancels assist (stock 245).
parameters.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults / LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: after sample count > 0x5F0, cmp adc,#imm. Unique imm8. Raising hides a shorted/disconnected sensor; lowering trips more easily on noise.

parameters.label: Torque sensor fault ADC high
parameters.summary: Upper torque-ADC fault limit during the 16-tick post-learn window (stock 2867 = 3000−133).
parameters.notes: LearnTorqueOffsetAndFaults: ldr lit 3000 then subs r1,#imm; fault if adc > 3000−imm in the count+offset < 16 window. Pool word 0x100080D0 is also the 3000-tick re-zero timer — only patch this subtract. Effective high = 3000−imm.

parameters.label: Unlimit speed when display sends 60 km/h
parameters.summary: Force display TX bit 0x40000 always on so the VD04 handshake is not stuck in legal 25/PAS 1, and remap fade math from 60 to 99 when the display sends 60. Motor taper is the 60→99 remap unless Disable speed fade is also on (that skips Apply taper in both display modes).
parameters.notes: Site 0x10008824 is bcc→b so UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit always ORs 0x40000 into the display TX word (same handshake as donor patched HEX). Clearing that bit at standstill keeps the VD04 in legal PAS-1 / 25 km/h so it never sends 60. Site 0x10008826 (protect-bit test) stays stock. Site 0x10008890 remaps a live display 60 to 99 in RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds. Does not disable fade; it moves the taper point. Disable speed fade patches ApplyWheelSpeedFade separately and does not overwrite this remap. Short b is scatter/RAM-safe.

parameters.label: Disable speed fade
parameters.summary: Skip the near-cap assist taper in ApplyWheelSpeedFade on both display 25 and 60. PAS percent, ride-current clamp, thermal, battery, and protect limits still apply.
parameters.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade is scatter-copied with the rest of the ride window to SRAM, so these short b encodings stay valid after the RAM copy. Site 0x100088F6 is bcs→b to 0x10008916 (always store full assist span; stock bcs 0x100088fe is 02 D2). Site 0x10008922 is bcs→b to 0x1000893e (always keep source current; stock bcs 0x1000892c is 03 D2). Same two sites as donor patched HEX. Does not patch RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds; Unlimit-when-display-60 still owns the handshake and 60→99 remap. 0x10008904 stays stock. Not literally full motor power — other limiters remain. On-road 25 and off-road 60 both skip motor fade.

parameters.label: Skip throttle assist-bit lockout
parameters.summary: Let the analog throttle map run even when dwAssistBits 0x40000 is set. That lockout bit is not the display TX 0x40000 handshake. PAS 0 still skips throttle.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop at 0x1000330C is bmi skip after lsls dwAssistBits #13 (bit 18 = 0x40000 on 0x20002690). UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog sets that bit when ADC > ~849 while the age counter is 6–159, and clears it only if ADC < 840. A rest ADC of 850–1200 latches the lockout so twist never stages (ADC−600)×2+800. Nop (00 BF) leaves the ADC window and PAS≠0 tests. Display TX bit 0x40000 at 0x20002B00 is a different word. If rest ADC is already above 840 after lowering the window floors, idle is treated as throttle-on — raise throttle_lockout_release and the three window floors together.

parameters.label: Bypass battery OV/UV flag branches
parameters.summary: Skip the battery over/under-voltage flag branches. The third site forces the raise path, but when avg is still below UV the limit can still fold back via (avg−UV)×2.
parameters.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: three branch rewrites (0x10002DA4, 0x10002DC8, 0x10002E12). The first two bypass OV/UV flag stores. The third does not fully skip low-voltage foldback: forcing the raise path while avg < UV still adds (avg−UV)×2 and can wind the limit down. Soft window/recovery sliders still apply on unpatched builds.

parameters.label: Speed-fade assist floor
parameters.summary: Minimum assist left when speed-fade cuts near/over the cap (stock 600). Raise to keep more power as you near the limit; unused if Disable speed fade is on.
parameters.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade: movs r6,#imm; lsls #3. Stock 75<<3 = 600. Applied when live wheel period is below the fade-at-cap threshold (smaller period = faster / at-or-over the speed cap), and as the +600 term in the fade interpolate. Not a low-speed floor. Skipped while PAS==6. Left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

parameters.label: Fade throttle ADC low edge
parameters.summary: Low edge of the throttle-in-window test inside ApplyWheelSpeedFade (stock −1241). Separate from the ride-loop Throttle ADC low edge slider.
parameters.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade unique literal at 0x100089B8. Window is abs(this) through fade_throttle_adc_high. The ride-loop / PAS-full −1241 at 0x100033E4 is throttle_adc_low and is not this word. Raise both when fitting an aftermarket throttle whose rest ADC sits above the stock window.

parameters.label: Fade throttle ADC high edge
parameters.summary: High edge of the throttle-in-window test inside ApplyWheelSpeedFade (stock 2679 = 2731−52). Aligns with PAS-full throttle span at stock.
parameters.notes: ApplyWheelSpeedFade: ldr lit 2731 from 0x10008980 then subs r6,#imm. Stock imm 0x34 → 2679, matching throttle_pas_full_span. The 2731 pool word is also ParseDisplayUartFrame command 0x08 and must stay locked; only this subtract is patched. Effective high = 2731−imm.

parameters.label: Speed-fade band numerator
parameters.summary: Fade-low = fade-high x numerator / divisor (stock 25). With stock 22 this starts the taper at cap x 22/25.
parameters.notes: RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds: movs r1,#imm then muls fade-high, then divide by speed_fade_band_divisor. Unique 19 21 at 0x100088AC. Not the ceiling movs r3,#0x19 or the torque-path 25<<5.

parameters.label: Speed-fade band divisor
parameters.summary: Divisor of the fade-low rebuild (stock 22). Lower starts the taper sooner; 0 would fault the unsigned divide.
parameters.notes: RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds unique movs r1,#0x16 at 0x100088B0 after muls r0,r1. Pair with speed_fade_band_numerator. The muls 48 43 is fingerprint-locked.

parameters.label: Long-period sample gate
parameters.summary: Increments a sample counter when the P0.4 wheel-pulse period is longer than this value<<5 (stock 125 → 4000 ticks). Stopped saturate is 4100, so stock only counts near-stopped pulses. Encoded like the display-status period threshold, not a km/h wall. No external reader of the counter has been found — likely inert in stock.
parameters.notes: CountLongWheelPulsePeriodSamples: movs r3,#imm; lsls #5 vs 0x20002590 (same period cell as Speed ceiling). Increments when period > threshold AND protect-bit<<29 is negative AND the sample-cap is not full. Counter at 0x200025C8 is only read/written here and zeroed by UpdateWheelPulsePeriod; no other recovered consumer (including RAM-aliased code). The left-shift is fingerprint-locked. Id suffix _kmh is historical; unit is period ticks after <<5.

parameters.label: Long-period sample cap
parameters.summary: How many long-period samples that counter may accumulate (stock 1000). Caps CountLongWheelPulsePeriodSamples. Likely inert — no external reader of the counter has been found.
parameters.notes: CountLongWheelPulsePeriodSamples: movs r2,#imm; lsls #3. Stock 0x7D<<3 = 1000. Same counter as long_period_sample_gate_kmh (0x200025C8); no recovered consumer outside this function. The left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

parameters.label: Wheel-period slew threshold
parameters.summary: When |delta| exceeds this, SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord also applies the bulk asrs step before the fine ±1 (stock 16). Smaller values track pulse-period changes more aggressively.
parameters.notes: SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord: both cmp #imm sites at 0x100089E4 / 0x10008A00. When |delta| > this, the filter first steps by delta>>N (see fade_period_slew_shift); afterward it always moves ±1 toward the target. Stock cmp is 16, not 2^N−1, so threshold and shift are independent sliders.

parameters.label: Wheel-period slew shift
parameters.summary: Bulk step size for SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord when |delta| exceeds the slew threshold (stock N=4 → delta>>4).
parameters.notes: SmoothWheelPeriodTargetWord: both asrs r3,#N sites at 0x100089E8 / 0x10008A04. Smaller N tracks wheel-pulse period changes faster (less filtering). Independent of ride_target_fade_delta because stock threshold 16 is not 2^N−1.

parameters.label: Wheel-period fade constant K
parameters.summary: Rebuilds fade-hi period as wheel_code×K/speed (stock K=573 = 819−246). Acts as a speed-calibration scale for when fade starts.
parameters.notes: RebuildWheelSpeedFadeThresholds: ldr lit 819 from 0x10008994 then subs #imm. Pool word is also the throttle-lockout trip compare at 0x10008780 — only patch this subtract. Effective K = 819−imm.

parameters.label: Wheel-pulse stuck-high timeout
parameters.summary: How long the P0.4 wheel-speed pin can stay high before the firmware treats the wheel as stopped (stock 2000 ticks).
parameters.notes: UpdateWheelPulsePeriod: if P0.4 high-time > imm<<4, period saturates to the stopped value. Stock 0x7D<<4 = 2000. Falling edges also call ApplyWheelSpeedFade.

parameters.label: Wheel-pulse stopped period
parameters.summary: Period written when the P0.4 wheel-speed pin looks stopped (stock 4100). Larger means it waits longer before calling the wheel stopped.
parameters.notes: Literal 0x00001004 used by UpdateWheelPulsePeriod. Low-time counter saturates here and the same value is written as the stopped period. The committed period is stored as period<<2 into a uint16, so values above 16383 wrap. This cell is also the UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit operand.

parameters.label: Wheel-pulse min high-time
parameters.summary: Ignore very short P0.4 pulses (noise). Stock needs more than 7 ticks of high time before a wheel pulse counts.
parameters.notes: UpdateWheelPulsePeriod: falling-edge period is committed only if high-time > this cmp. Stock 7 means a committed pulse needs at least 8 ticks.

parameters.label: Thermal protect low band
parameters.summary: Averaged NTC percent that clears thermal protect when strictly below this (stock 75). Not a current-shunt ADC.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop averages LookupTemperatureAdcPercent (not a shunt ADC). Clear-protect is strict less-than this cmp; equal to 75 stays in the interpolate band. Keep this below Thermal protect high band. The interpolate is (high-T)*cell>>4, so the stock 16-wide gap (91-75) is hard-wired; moving only one band makes the ramp discontinuous. High NTC ADC ≥944 forces percent 60, which sits in this clear-protect band.

parameters.label: Thermal protect high band
parameters.summary: Upper reference of the thermal fade band (stock 91). Fade already runs from the low band through this value; ≥92 enters the countdown/trip path.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: both cmp #imm sites (0x1000353A / 0x10003558). Ramp operates from thermal_protect_low_band through this high reference; equality stays in the fade band. Values above this enter the protect countdown.

parameters.label: NTC ADC overrange
parameters.summary: NTC ADC at or above this forces the lookup percent to the overrange value (stock 944). Capped at stock so hotter ADCs cannot skip the overrange percent.
parameters.notes: LookupTemperatureAdcPercent: movs r1,#imm; lsls #4; if adc >= that, return the forced percent. Stock 0x3B<<4 = 944. Raising this above 944 lets ADCs between the old and new threshold fall through the table. The left-shift is fingerprint-locked.

parameters.label: NTC overrange percent
parameters.summary: Percent written when NTC ADC is overrange (stock 60). Stock 60 sits in the thermal clear-protect band.
parameters.notes: LookupTemperatureAdcPercent: movs r0,#imm after the 944 compare. Unique. Keep this in mind vs Thermal protect low/high bands.

parameters.label: Battery voltage window
parameters.summary: OV-clear and UV-trip offset (stock 32 counts ≈ 0.68 V). Both subtract sites stay in sync.
parameters.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: subs vs the over-voltage threshold at 0x10002DAC and vs the under-voltage threshold at 0x10002DC2. Not a current limiter. Skip battery voltage guards skips the flag branches but does not rewrite these immediates.

parameters.label: Battery UV recovery
parameters.summary: Added to the under-voltage threshold before clearing the UV latch (stock 93 counts ≈ 1.99 V).
parameters.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: adds r0,#imm then cmp the averaged pack-voltage ADC. Unique adds #0x5D.

parameters.label: Battery average sample count
parameters.summary: Battery monitor runs when the sample counter reaches this (stock 16). Averaging uses >>4 at stock; large changes desync the shift.
parameters.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: cmp sample_count,#imm before averaging. Stock 16 matches the >>4 mean. Changing far from a power of two without a matching shift rewrite skews the average.

parameters.label: Battery UV pre-debounce
parameters.summary: How long average voltage must stay below UV−window before the secondary UV latch counter advances (stock 5).
parameters.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: first UV debounce cmp #imm after the battery_voltage_window subtract. Pair with battery_uv_latch_threshold.

parameters.label: Battery UV latch threshold
parameters.summary: Secondary UV counter threshold before the under-voltage latch sets (stock 3).
parameters.notes: UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor: cmp on the secondary UV counter after battery_uv_predebounce. Lower trips UV faster; higher tolerates brief dips.

parameters.label: Pack UV cutoff
parameters.summary: Pack under-voltage cutoff copied by LoadMotorScaleDefaults (stock 41.0 V). Soft foldback plus hard UV still use the ADC window/recovery sliders.
parameters.notes: Float32 41.0 at 0x10003A24; unique ldr from LoadMotorScaleDefaults into the scale table. UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor compares averaged pack ADC against the derived UV threshold. Pair with Battery voltage window (+/-32 counts) and Battery UV recovery (+93).

parameters.label: Pack OV cutoff
parameters.summary: Pack over-voltage cutoff copied by LoadMotorScaleDefaults (stock 65.0 V). Unique float; the 64.0f store in the same function is a separate seed.
parameters.notes: Float32 65.0 at 0x10003A28; unique ldr from LoadMotorScaleDefaults. UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor trips OV using the derived threshold into 0x200025F0. Soft window/recovery sliders still apply. Do not confuse with the hardcoded 64.0f written beside this pool.

parameters.label: Pack nominal voltage
parameters.summary: Nominal pack voltage used as the Q14 voltage-ratio divisor (stock 48.0 V). Keep this near the real pack; far values skew every derived current limit.
parameters.notes: Float32 48.0 at 0x10003A10; unique ldr in LoadMotorScaleDefaults. ComputeDerivedScaleTables / UpdateBatteryVoltageMonitor divide avg<<14 by the 48 V scale. Narrow band because it feeds many derived cells.

parameters.label: Pack max current
parameters.summary: Scale-table max current setpoint (stock 22.0 A). High risk: derived signed-16 cells wrap above ~71 A. Can overheat the controller.
parameters.notes: Float32 22.0 at 0x10003A18; unique ldr in LoadMotorScaleDefaults into the scale table. ComputeMotorScaleTables converts it into g_wMaxCurrentSetpoint (stock ≈10147 counts; sxth wraps above ~71 A). Cap 30 A stays well under the wrap. Ride current clamp is a separate int16 override from the fixed 6200.0 float. Raising this alone mainly lifts PAS FOC caps that are fractions of max current; the ride-loop 6200 clamp still binds until Ride current clamp is raised.

parameters.label: Overload cutout arm time
parameters.summary: How long the ride loop must see protect-bit 2 before the shunt overload compare can cut out (stock 800 ticks).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: movs r1,#imm; lsls #5; if the 0x200025A8 counter is above that AND shunt > 641+overload_cutout_margin, set dwAssistBits bit 2 and DisableMotorOutput. Left-shift is fingerprint-locked. Pair with Pack max current.

parameters.label: Overload cutout margin
parameters.summary: Added to the 641 baseline before overload cutout (stock 49 → first trip at 691). Units are the 8-sample shunt average cell, not proven amperes.
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop unique adds r1,#imm onto literal 641 at 0x10003438. Strict compare is 641+this < cell at 0x20002584 (8-sample average from CalculateTwoShuntPhaseCurrents; display current byte is that cell>>6). Stock first trips at 691. Max imm 255 → trip at 896 counts. Ampere equivalence is unverified — do not treat this as a calibrated amp slider. Does not rewrite the 22.0 A scale-table float.

parameters.label: Protect assist-bit clear delay
parameters.summary: After overload/protect cutout ends, how long before assist bit 0x20 is cleared (stock 500 ticks).
parameters.notes: RunRideControlLoop: when protect is inactive, counter at 0x200025A8 rises; above 255+imm clears dwAssistBits bit 0x20. Stock 0xF5 → 500. Separate from Overload cutout arm time (800) which gates the trip.

parameters.label: UART silence protect timeout
parameters.summary: UART-silence counter at 0x200025A4 trips after this many ticks (stock 200). Separate from PWM idle shutdown and the throttle-ADC watchdog age saturate, which also use #0xC8.
parameters.notes: IncrementUartSilenceProtectCounter ages 0x200025A4. cmp r0,#imm; above this, bit20 of 0x20002694 is cleared. Same immediate as PWM idle and UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog age saturate; different RAM cell.

parameters.label: Throttle-ADC watchdog age
parameters.summary: How long the throttle-ADC watchdog age byte may increment before it saturates (stock 200). Keep at or above 160 so the lockout window can still close.
parameters.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog reads the throttle ADC cell 0x20002528. If the age byte < imm, increment. Third cmp #0xC8 in the image. Values below ~160 can leave the throttle lockout window open.

parameters.label: Throttle overrange
parameters.summary: Stuck-high throttle ADC threshold (stock 3686). Above this the watchdog ages toward the fault bit.
parameters.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog unique literal DAT_10008998. If throttle ADC > this, the second age counter increments and at throttle_adc_fault_age sets dwAssistBits 0x40000. 12-bit ADC tops out at 4095.

parameters.label: Throttle-ADC fault age
parameters.summary: Debounce for throttle ADC stuck above Throttle overrange (stock 100 ticks). Not a stale/missing-sample timer.
parameters.notes: UpdateThrottleAdcWatchdog: cmp r0,#imm after the overrange age. Writes dwAssistBits 0x40000 on 0x20002690 when ADC > throttle_overrange for this many ticks. Not a missing-sample / stale-ADC timer.

parameters.label: Torque slew current floor
parameters.summary: Minimum FOC current during the torque slew window (stock 300). Raise for a stronger floor while torque is ramping.
parameters.notes: ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit: movs r0,#255; adds r0,#imm; if foc-state+0x10 < that, clamp to it. Stock 255+0x2D = 300. Assist floor during the slew window.

parameters.label: Torque slew timeout
parameters.summary: How many samples the torque slew may run before it aborts and restores the saved motor angle (stock 50).
parameters.notes: ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit: abort after sample index > this cmp; clears flag bit 4 and restores the saved electrical angle. Stock 50. The same count cell is also capped by a RAM window from ComputeMotorScaleTables (0x200025DC); this timeout only fires if that window is above this value.

parameters.label: PLL rate clamp high
parameters.summary: Upper limit on the motor’s electrical-speed tracker (stock 2400). Wrong values can make the FOC loop hunt or lose lock.
parameters.notes: ProcessParkCurrentPiLoop: movs r2,#imm; lsls #5. Upper clamp on the PLL/electrical-rate cell. Stock 75<<5 = 2400. Asymmetric vs the -1024 low clamp.

parameters.label: PLL rate clamp low
parameters.summary: Lower limit on the same electrical-speed tracker (stock −1024). Pair with the high clamp; do not set this to a large positive number.
parameters.notes: Literal int32 0xFFFFFC00. Lower clamp on the same PLL/electrical-rate cell as pll_rate_clamp_high.

parameters.label: Stall mag-squared
parameters.summary: Dead sensorless path: would trip when raw Clarke mag² is below this (stock 20000). Patching has no effect on stock.
parameters.notes: HandleUnreachableSvmStallProtect at 0x10009310: if raw Clarke mag² at 0x20002AEC < this literal, equalize PWM. Reconfirmed unreachable after scatter-load/RAM-alias scan (no BL, pointer, or vector). Unrelated 20000 at 0x10002F84 is battery logic.

parameters.label: UART frame byte0 timeout
parameters.summary: While UART RX buffer byte0 at 0x200025C4 is nonzero, clear it after this many timeslice ticks (stock 1000). Not a motor-stall timer.
parameters.notes: DispatchMotorControlTimeslice: cell 0x200025C4 is also the ParseDisplayUartFrame RX frame base (byte0 = command index). While nonzero, increment a timer; at >= imm<<3 store 0. Stock 0x7D<<3 = 1000. Formerly mislabeled motor_stall_flag_timeout — no stall relation found. Sensorless Clarke/SVM stall code remains unreachable.

parameters.label: Stall phase-balance count
parameters.summary: Dead sensorless path: phase-balance counter trip (stock 32000). Patching has no effect on stock.
parameters.notes: HandleUnreachableSvmStallProtect: trips with mag² path when phase-balance count >= imm<<8 (stock 0x7D<<8 = 32000). Reconfirmed unreachable after RAM-alias scan — keep only for experiments on alternate images.

parameters.label: Hall angle offset
parameters.summary: Rotates the hall-sensor electrical angle by 30° stock (Q16 0x1555). Not a speed or power knob. Wrong values make the motor noisy, weak, or jerk.
parameters.notes: HandleHallSixStepCommutation adds this literal to LookupHallCommutationAngle. Stock 0x1555 = 65536/12 = 30 electrical degrees. The hall sector table at 0x1000722C steps by 0x2AAA (60°); 60° here would be 0x2AAB. Copies at 0x100025B4 (enable path) and 0x10009048 (ProcessHallAngleAdvance) are patched together so commutation stays in sync.

parameters.label: Hall advance high threshold
parameters.summary: Hall-rate above which the largest startup hall-angle advance is used (stock 3000).
parameters.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance first band: if hall rate > this literal, add hall_advance_high. Mid/low thresholds are separate movs<<N sliders; low-band advance amount is coupled to hall_advance_mid_threshold.

parameters.label: Hall advance high
parameters.summary: Electrical-angle advance applied above the high threshold (stock 5000 ≈ 27.5°). Wrong values jerk at takeoff.
parameters.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance: added to LookupHallCommutationAngle when hall rate > hall_advance_high_threshold. Q16 turns; 65536 ≈ 360°.

parameters.label: Hall advance medium
parameters.summary: Electrical-angle advance for the mid hall-rate band (stock 3500 ≈ 19.2°).
parameters.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance else-branch add when rate is above hall_advance_mid_threshold and not above hall_advance_high_threshold. Low-band +advance shares the mid-threshold immediate.

parameters.label: Hall advance mid threshold
parameters.summary: Hall-rate band edge for the medium advance (stock 2000 = 125<<4). Also supplies the coupled low-band +2000 advance amount.
parameters.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance: movs #imm; lsls #4. Rate bands: >high_thr → +high, >this → +medium, >low_thr → +this same register value, else 0. Changing this moves both the mid boundary and the low-band advance magnitude.

parameters.label: Hall advance low threshold
parameters.summary: Lower edge of the low hall-advance band (stock 1000 = 125<<3). No amount coupling on this immediate.
parameters.notes: ProcessHallAngleAdvance: movs #imm; lsls #3. Unique from the mid-threshold encoding. Keep below hall_advance_mid_threshold.

parameters.label: Clarke mag IIR (new)
parameters.summary: Dead Clarke IIR: Q15 weight on the new mag² sample (stock 2768). Patching has no effect on stock.
parameters.notes: HandleUnreachableClarkePhaseCurrents: movs #imm; lsls #4 Q15 new-weight (stock 0xAD<<4 = 2768). Complementary prev-weight 30000 is fingerprint-locked. Reconfirmed unreachable after RAM-alias scan.

parameters.label: FOC PI update interval
parameters.summary: How many FOC ISR loops between fixed-point PI updates (stock 16).
parameters.notes: ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr: loop counter at motor-state+0x10; when >= this, reset and call UpdateFixedPointPiOutput. Lower updates the outer PI more often (more CPU).

parameters.label: FOC duty bulk-step threshold
parameters.summary: Upward FOC duty errors larger than this step by delta>>5 instead of +1 (stock 31).
parameters.notes: ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr: cmp duty-delta,#imm; bls fine +1 path, else lsrs #5 bulk path. Sibling of the throttle ramp-up bulk threshold but on the FOC duty integrator.

parameters.label: FOC throttle gate base
parameters.summary: FOC ISR throttle-in-window low edge (stock 1240). When ADC is in-window and PAS≠0 the ISR skips the torque-demand cap. Separate from Throttle ADC low edge.
parameters.notes: ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr: movs #imm; lsls #3 → stock 0x9B<<3=1240 (=0x4D8). Span literal 0x939 is shared with a 2300-tick hold timer and is not exposed. Align with throttle_adc_low (~1241) when retuning the handlebar window.

parameters.label: FOC inner PI Kp seed
parameters.summary: Proportional gain for the inner d/q current PI blocks at init (stock 400). Not the outer current-loop Kp.
parameters.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #255; adds #imm; strh to 0x200025D4. InitializeFocPiControllers copies that halfword into PI blocks A/B Kp. The same register is then lsls #1 into unread 0x200025D8 (800) — patching Kp also changes that dead init word. Outer-loop gain is foc_outer_pi_kp (4864).

parameters.label: FOC inner PI Ki seed
parameters.summary: Integral gain for the inner d/q current PI blocks at init (stock 2). Not the outer current-loop Ki.
parameters.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs r2,#imm; strh to unread +2 then later strh to 0x200025D6. InitializeFocPiControllers copies 0x200025D6 into PI blocks A/B Ki. Outer-loop Ki is foc_outer_pi_ki (16).

parameters.label: FOC outer PI Kp
parameters.summary: Outer current-loop proportional gain (stock 4864 = 0x13<<8 ≈ 1.19 in Q12). Runs about every foc_pi_update_interval ISRs.
parameters.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #imm; lsls #8; strh to 0x200025D0. InitializeFocPiControllers copies that into PI block C Kp. ProcessFocCurrentControlIsr calls UpdateFixedPointPiOutput on block C (target vs feedback current) every foc_pi_update_interval. High risk — keep near 50–200% of stock. Separate from foc_pi_kp (inner 400).

parameters.label: FOC outer PI Ki
parameters.summary: Outer current-loop integral gain (stock 16). Pair with FOC outer PI Kp.
parameters.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #imm; strh to 0x200025D2. InitializeFocPiControllers copies into PI block C Ki. Same ~1 kHz path as foc_outer_pi_kp. Raising winds the outer integrator faster; keep small relative to Kp.

parameters.label: FOC Vq limit floor
parameters.summary: While SVM is saturated, the q-axis voltage clamp walks down 1 count per PWM period to this floor (stock 3000). 4095 disables the walk-down.
parameters.notes: CalculateFocParkInverseSvm: when status bit29 is set (ComputeSpaceVectorPwmDuties over-modulation), if Vq limit > this, subtract 1/ISR; else grow toward 4095. Bit29 is set/cleared live — earlier notes that it is never set were wrong. Ceiling literal 0xfff matches the init limit and is not exposed.

parameters.label: PWM re-arm delay
parameters.summary: ISR ticks that must elapse after PWM disable before EnableMotorPwmWhenReady may re-enable (stock 6000 ≈ 0.38 s at 15.6 kHz).
parameters.notes: EnableMotorPwmWhenReady: enable only when counter 0x200025E0 > this literal. Counter zeroes in DisableMotorOutput and increments once per FOC ISR, saturating at 16000 (0x7D<<7). Must stay below 16000 or PWM never re-arms. Lower = faster restart after cutout/brake/fault.

parameters.label: Hall torque-angle sample limit
parameters.summary: How long ProcessHallAngleAdvance may stay in the torque-advance path before forcing a hall re-latch (stock 4000).
parameters.notes: LoadMotorScaleDefaults: movs #imm; lsls #5; strh to 0x200025DC. ProcessHallAngleAdvance (live FOC ISR callee) compares the sample counter to that halfword and, when exceeded, re-reads hall bits, ApplyHallSectorPwmPattern, and reapplies hall_angle_offset. Sibling unread scale halfwords 800/600 at +0xC/+0xE have zero recovered readers and are not exposed.

parameters.label: Motor-running current floor
parameters.summary: Filtered shunt-current average at 0x20002584 must be strictly above this before the motor-running debounce can count up (stock 600).
parameters.notes: UpdateMotorRunningDebounce: movs #imm; lsls #3; cmp r4,r7; ble skip — arming requires current > floor (signed), not >=. Cell 0x20002584 is the 8-sample shunt average from CalculateTwoShuntPhaseCurrents (also zeroed on PWM enable/disable). UpdateDisplayWheelPeriodStatusBit additionally asrs>>6 the same halfword into a display TX speed byte — it is not a wheel-pulse period. Pair with motor_running_period_gate.

parameters.label: Motor-running period gate
parameters.summary: P0.4 wheel-pulse period must stay below this for the motor-running flag to arm (stock 4000). Debounce depth is this value >> 3 (stock 500).
parameters.notes: UpdateMotorRunningDebounce: movs #imm; lsls #5 vs 0x20002590 (same period cell as Speed ceiling / Long-period gate). The arming debounce compare uses asrs of the same register (imm<<5>>3 = imm<<2; stock 500). Patching this therefore scales both the period gate and the debounce depth together. Near the stopped saturate 4100.

preserve.label: UART start-byte compare (0x59)
